summary:
What does it take to become an astronaut? Cosmic Cadet is a web-based 2D educational adventure game that makes learning about astronaut training and space exploration fun through interactive gameplay.

Players create their own astronaut profile, customize their characters, and embark on two exciting minigames. In Defying Gravity, players navigate through asteroids, avoid obstacles, and collect coins. In Satellite Rescue, they complete multiple levels involving satellite operations and rescue challenges. Players can also test their space knowledge through the Knowledge Check quiz.

The game features a credit and upgrade system where players earn rewards to unlock helmet colours and gameplay enhancements. A Mission History system also records their scores, achievements, completion times, and earned credits.

Developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, Cosmic Cadet combines pixel-art visuals, interactive challenges, and educational content to make space exploration more engaging and accessible while inspiring curiosity about STEM and astronaut training.
details:
1. PROJECT OVERVIEW

COSMIC CADET is a web-based 2D educational game that introduces players to astronaut training and space exploration through interactive missions. Players take on the role of aspiring astronauts and complete challenges while learning about space in a fun and engaging way.

2. HOW DOES IT WORK?

Players create their own astronaut profile and begin their training through three main activities. In Defying Gravity, players navigate through asteroids, avoid obstacles, and collect coins to earn credits. In Satellite Rescue, they complete three levels involving space exploration and satellite rescue challenges. The Knowledge Check quiz allows players to answer space-related questions and test their knowledge.

Players can use their earned credits to unlock helmet colours and purchase game upgrades. Their scores, achievements, completion times, and rewards are recorded in Mission History, allowing them to track their progress.

3. BENEFITS AND IMPACT

COSMIC CADET makes learning about space more interactive and enjoyable by introducing players to astronaut training and satellite operations. Through its missions and challenges, the game encourages problem-solving and decision-making while building interest in science, technology, engineering and mathematics (STEM). Its reward system, character customization, and mission progression also motivate players to continue learning and exploring.

The goal is to make space education more accessible and inspire curiosity about becoming an astronaut.

4. TOOLS AND TECHNOLOGIES

The project was developed using HTML5 for the website structure and game interfaces, CSS3 for visual design, layouts and animations, and JavaScript for gameplay, scoring, rewards and interactions. Browser Local Storage is used to save player profiles, credits, upgrades and mission history. Pixel-art sprites are also used to create the characters, enemies and space environments. The game runs directly in a web browser without requiring specialised hardware.

5. CREATIVITY AND INNOVATION

What makes COSMIC CADET different is its combination of education and arcade-style gameplay. Instead of simply reading about space or answering questions, players experience astronaut training through interactive challenges.

The game also features personalized astronaut characters, unlockable helmet colours, collectible coins, gameplay upgrades and a Mission History system. These features make learning more engaging while giving players a reason to keep exploring.

6. FACTORS CONSIDERED

During development, several important factors were considered. User experience was prioritised by providing simple navigation and easy-to-understand controls. Educational value was maintained by designing activities related to space exploration and astronaut training. Engagement was encouraged through rewards and challenges, while consistent pixel-art graphics and space-themed interfaces helped create an appealing visual design. Accessibility was also considered by making the game browser-based, so players do not need specialised equipment. Finally, the progress tracking system allows players to review their achievements and mission results.

7. CONCLUSION

COSMIC CADET turns the journey of becoming an astronaut into an interactive adventure. By combining space education, exciting minigames and rewarding progression, the game aims to make learning more enjoyable while inspiring the next generation to explore science and the universe.
